fields.description: Stored encrypted; only ***** is ever shown. Leave a field unchanged to keep the current value. A TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET environment variable on the server, if set, takes precedence.

fields.description: Creates an inactive Telegram Chat record when the bot is added to a chat, so an administrator can review and activate it.

fields.default: This bot manages access to company Telegram groups and channels. If you request access, we record your Telegram user ID, username, display name and the time of the request so HR can verify your identity and grant access. We will never ask for passwords, login codes or other sensitive data.
fields.description: Shown on /start. The bot never asks for passwords or login codes.
fields.label: Privacy Notice

fields.default: Please contact HR if you need help.
fields.label: Support Contact Text

fields.description: Join requests in managed chats from users without an explicit Allow are declined.
